# Independent lyxose finalization helper review

Verdict: changes requested. This review covers the 79-artifact finalization helper
package, not the earlier integration helpers authored by this reviewer. All 79
sealed artifact hashes and all 6,444 actual checkpoint files were independently
verified. The full native inspector accepted all 6,444 inputs; the author's ten
bounded guard tests also passed. No maintained operation or full suite was run.

The saved payload truthfully uses self_review, names the author/preparer role,
and explicitly inherits the original and successor independent science plus the
canonical audit. Its 109 unchanged predecessor edges, two added edges, 66
references, ten qualifiers and external issue dispositions match the accepted
scientific review. No fabricated native previous_occurrences or premature issue
closure is present. UTF-8 wrappers preserve CRLF, Unicode and trailing newlines.
Native save/history APIs and fresh append-only paths are used as intended.

Three guard defects require a successor before finalization:

1. Missing/empty native receipt sets and absent inspect lineage can pass the final
   completion seal. Require exact receipt keys, actual command/output lineage and
   the bound assembly/config/archive chain in a shared verifier.
2. Current-file rows can point to an external old copy while naming a changed
   relative file inside ROOT. Require exact rooted path identity and complete,
   unique, safe inventory before verifying bytes.
3. Duplicate archive destinations pass preflight and leave a partial append before
   FileExistsError. Reject duplicate and ancestor-file conflicts before writes.

The full helper package is still unexecuted for maintained finalization. These
findings are isolated external reproductions, not evidence that root fabricated
or lost any actual receipt. Root confirmed real gates and preservation are being
completed separately; this review does not relabel those results.

A broad filename search under /private/tmp was interrupted after unrelated
broken symlink errors; no absence conclusion relies on it. Exact relevant paths
were then read directly. Original sealed helper artifacts remain unchanged.
